expected: Unmeasured estimate of +5–8 percentage points in all-pass; the main risk is losing draft diversity when the initial implementation has a fundamentally poor approach.
hypothesis: Replacing two independent Luna drafts with a second Sol review/Luna repair round will increase hidden all-pass by correcting defects and regressions that survive the first repair.
mechanism: Change only the call allocation: Luna draft → Sol review → Luna repair → Sol review → Luna repair. Keep the incumbent’s prompts, review effort, public testing, candidate filtering, and submission policy. Each review considers all eligible files generated so far. The additional review and repair are coupled because Sol’s findings require a subsequent Luna call to produce a submitted file.
